title: vitex trifolia var. taihangensis
intro: Vitex trifolia var. taihangensis, commonly known as Taiwan Vitex, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include relaxing muscles, reducing stress and anxiety, and aiding in the treatment of insomnia and menstrual disorders. Bioactive constituents of Taiwan Vitex include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
